task.question: Who was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics on 6 October 2026?
task.evidence: 6 October – Francis Halzen is awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin. The observatory uses sensors embedded deep in Antarctic ice to detect neutrinos from distant cosmic sources.
